blockers.title: GitHub autonomous merge and required-check authority is not established
blockers.description: AGENTS.md reserves repository security settings and main merges for explicit owner authorization. CI can be prepared in a PR, but rulesets, merge queue, tokens/secrets, and unattended merge acceptance require owner action.
blockers.next_step: Keep PR-based integration; prepare a least-privilege setup checklist without changing repository settings.

blockers.description: Static review found deleted-file selection gaps, missing project-control suite mapping, duplicate push/PR execution risk, a scheduled expensive benchmark matrix, and CPU-only Qwen3 execution in the model job. The divergent candidate branch must not be merged wholesale.
